summary:
This project is about creating software to monitor astronauts’ health during space missions. It helps detect health problems and keep astronauts safe.
Astronauts face health risks in space due to low gravity and extreme conditions. Monitoring their health is important.
We chose this project because astronauts need technology to check their health and prevent medical problems.
First, we researched astronauts’ health needs. Then, we selected important vital signs and designed software to collect information and send alerts.
This software helps protect astronauts, detect health problems, and make space missions safer.
details: Our project is a health monitoring system for astronauts. It includes a smart suit with built-in sensors that monitor heart rate, body temperature, and other vital signs. The suit protects astronauts and helps detect health problems. It also includes the ASTROSCAN device, which displays medical images and health results. Our goal is to improve medical care, protect astronauts, and make space missions safer through technology and innovation.
